scope: Descriptive sums and known means of existing recorded scalar fields; no score recalculation or new behavioral coding.

formal_physical_resources.scope_note: Each token field sums distinct physical groups once. Token categories overlap and must not be added together. Per-trajectory tokens describe the same recorded work and are not additional incurred cost.

technical_physical_resources.scope_note: Each token field sums distinct physical groups once. Token categories overlap and must not be added together. Per-trajectory tokens describe the same recorded work and are not additional incurred cost.

limitations: Unknown or absent scalars remain unknown; recorded outcomes are not inferred from scores or hidden reasoning.
Known sums and means cover only known observations. A missing complete sum does not imply zero cost.
Trajectory means weight recorded positions; Audit orders and HPO repetitions are not independent experimental units. Score settings retain the upstream hierarchical item means.
Fewer tool or API calls alone do not demonstrate better behavior, efficiency, or task performance.
Recorded reasoning_tokens is a usage field and does not reveal or validate hidden reasoning content.
Formal and technical physical resource groups remain separate; trajectory and resource summaries overlap and must not be added.
Historical settings use the updated v2 reference (upstream main 2a78fc8 / rescore 0e6); this is a secondary comparison across versions, prompts, deployment, time, and scoring provenance.
